annotations.title: Job Openings Index (open US job postings, daily)

description: The VeritaHire Job Openings Index: open US job postings measured every day from employers' own careers sites and published the next morning - the index (base 100), its 7-day average, its change over a day, a week and 28 days, the share of postings put up and taken down in the last week, the latest official JOLTS month for comparison, and the daily series. Free (CC BY 4.0).

days.description: How many days of the series to return (default 30)
